results.title: Niger is demanding that France return the uranium extracted from its territory since 1968 or pay fair compensation. The demand is part of a dispute with French nuclear company Orano, which operated uranium mines in the country for decades. Niger says the uranium was sold at prices below market value and is reviewing past contracts, revenue payments and environmental damage. The country has since taken control of the main mine and cancelled Orano’s mining rights, while legal disputes continue.
